title: Spineshudder Amulet

fields.Crackling Resonance: Once per attack, dealing damage with a ranged spell attack adds 2 turns of Reverberation. The blasts from Fungal Bamboozler, Merregon Potion and Noxious Spore Grenade count as spell attacks.
fields.Reverberation: Each turn remaining imposes −1 to Strength, Dexterity and Constitution saves. At 5 or more turns, take 1d4 Thunder and make a DC 10 Constitution save or fall Prone for 2 turns, then clear the condition. The penalty also applies to that save. The pinned source reports Thunder-immune creatures can still receive Reverberation and the five-turn burst does not occur in real-time mode.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
